filters.F0: all development-observed completions in the release class, including candidates without a usable start
filters.F1: available candidate context and the same exposure bin as the target
filters.F2: available candidate context and the same prior-performance bin as the target

p: (s+1)/(n+2) compared with exact integer inequalities, without rounding
window: last 40 valid completed interactions with end < start
support: P00 on the retained candidate multiset
scoring_history: the target learner's own pre-event history, not the candidate history
